title: Is the cookie banner compact and quick to accept or reject?
Does the main navigation focus on the pages that make money?
Do menu labels name product types in the words shoppers use?
After signing up for a discount, does the code appear on screen right away?
Do dead-end pages (404, no search results, blog, About) offer a next step?
Does the tab title change to bring back shoppers who switch tabs?
Does search suggest products and categories as the shopper types?
Does the design avoid pure black (#000000) for text and backgrounds?
Is the hero a single message, not an auto-rotating slider?
Are the main categories shown as photo tiles in the first two screens?
Are at least two shopping benefits (shipping, returns, guarantee) visible in the first screen?
Does the homepage show at least three customer reviews?
When a promotion applies to this category, is it shown above the grid?
Does applying a filter update the products without losing your place?
Does the menu show which section the shopper is in?
Does the gallery show the product on more than one body type or size?
Does at least one gallery image point out features with text or arrows?
Is there a size guide next to the size picker that opens without leaving the page?
Are measurements shown in the shopper's units?
When a product or size is sold out, can the shopper ask to be notified?
If the brand sells on sustainability, does the page give concrete facts?
Can the shopper ask a question from the product page?
On mobile, is it clear the gallery holds more images to swipe?
Does the page show outside credibility (press, experts, awards) for this product?
Does the page help the shopper choose between similar products?
Does at least one gallery image show the product with another product it is used with?
Do products without reviews show the store's reviews instead?
If origin is a selling point, does the page say where and how the product is made?
Are 2 to 5 key benefits listed in the buy box?
Are customer photos featured where shoppers see them, not buried in reviews?
When a variant is picked, do the images, price and stock update to match?
If the shopper forgets to pick a size, does the page say so next to the size picker?
Does the page say a return label is included (when it is)?
Is it obvious that the product was added to the cart?
Can the shopper zoom into product images to see fine details?
On mobile, does the checkout button stay visible while scrolling the cart?
For higher order values, does the cart show the installment amount?
Does the cart suggest a relevant, low-priced add-on?
Is there a reassurance line next to the checkout button?
On desktop, does the checkout button in the cart react on hover and look clickable?
Is delivery protection offered at checkout?
Is the phone number optional?
Are express buttons kept from taking over the top of checkout?
Does checkout keep the shipping promise made earlier (price, free threshold, delivery time)?
When the checkout asks for a phone number, does it say why?
Is the pay button the most prominent element in checkout?
Can shoppers pick a delivery day or time slot when it matters?
Is there a one-click offer after payment, before the thank-you page?
Does the card form show where to find the security code (CVC)?
On mobile, does each field open the right keyboard (email, numbers)?
Is typed information kept after an error, or when the shopper leaves and comes back?
Does the phone field accept any format and preselect the country code?
Does the address field suggest addresses as the shopper types?
Does browser autofill fill the checkout correctly?
Do errors show next to the field, say what is wrong and how to fix it?
Does the page say when the order will arrive, with which carrier, and how tracking will reach the shopper?
If the shopper did not opt in at checkout, does the page offer a second chance to subscribe?
Does the page offer a personalized product recommendation based on the customer’s purchase?
Does the page offer the customer a coupon code for their next purchase?
Can the shopper easily get help after ordering (contact or quick answers)?
Does the page clearly state that the purchase was successfully completed and congratulate the customer?
Is there a visible link or button to view or print the order receipt?
Does the page push one main next step instead of stacking offers?
Does the page encourage social following?
Does the page invite customers to join a loyalty, rewards or referral program?
Does the page display trust elements like satisfaction guarantees, return policies?
Does the page clearly summarize what was in the order?
Does the page ask a one-question survey (how they found you, what almost stopped them)?
Do search results look like a category page (grid, prices, filters)?
Is the footer equipped with a language or currency switcher (if applicable)?
Are search results optimized for mobile with touch-friendly design?
Are Accelerated Mobile Pages (AMP) implemented?
Does the cart widget show relevant cart-related messages (e.g., free shipping threshold)?
Is the search bar prominently visible and functional?
Is there a clear and visible "Cart" button within the cart widget?
Does the cart widget update instantly when items are added or removed?
Are pop-ups and overlays mobile-friendly, non-intrusive, and easy to close?
Does the cart widget provide a quick cart summary on hover or click?
If empty, does the cart widget invite the user to continue shopping or log in to restore their basket?
Are page load speeds optimized for mobile, ideally loading in under 3 seconds?
Is the cart icon clearly visible and easily identifiable?
Is the navigation responsive and optimized for mobile?
Is there a clear and visible "Checkout" button within the cart widget?
Is above-the-fold content prioritized?
Are product images and galleries swipe-friendly on mobile devices?
Are all images optimized for mobile to ensure fast loading times without sacrificing quality?
Does the search bar provide suggestions for zero-results scenarios (e.g., related products or alternative search terms)?
Is there a "Track my order" link in the header, footer or help menu that works without an account?
Does the 404 page help the shopper continue (search, bestsellers, main categories)?
Do the help or contact pages say how fast you answer ("We reply within 24 hours")?
Is there a product finder or quiz for shoppers who don't know what to pick?
Does the About page show the people or the story behind the brand?
Does the search bar handle typos, misspellings, and synonyms effectively?
Are regular performance audits conducted?
Is the database performance optimized?
Is the hosting environment optimized for speed?
Are search results personalized based on user behavior or history?
Do text and buttons have enough contrast to read (4.5:1 for normal text)?
Do videos stay silent until the shopper turns sound on?
Can customers log in with a one-time email code instead of a password?
Do icon-only buttons (search, cart, menu, close) have a label for screen readers?
When moving through the page with the keyboard, can you see where you are (visible focus outline)?
Does the homepage promote site-wide offers at the top of the page (e.g., Free Shipping) with urgency and scarcity triggers?
Once you land on the homepage, do you immediately know the main products the store is selling?
Has the hero section been tested using a 5-second test to ensure key messages are clear?
Are urgency and scarcity triggers (e.g., limited stock, time-limited sale) used effectively within the category page?
Are products displayed in a grid or list format that can be toggled by users?
Are active filters shown as removable chips, with a "Clear all"?
Does the mobile filter panel say how many products match before applying ("Show 24 results")?
Do product cards show the colours available (swatches or "4 colours")?
On desktop, does a product card show a second image on hover?
After opening a product and pressing back, does the shopper land where they were in the list?
Is there a section showing similar products or recently viewed items to enhance the shopping experience?
Are breadcrumbs visible to help navigate back to previous categories?
Are old prices and discounts clearly displayed when the product is on sale?
Are different shipping method options and costs clearly outlined?
Is the "What’s Included" section clear, detailing all items or accessories in the package?
Does the main CTA change state after a product is added to the cart (e.g., “Product added!”)?
Does the page address common objections with clear answers (e.g., product fit, durability, or care instructions)?
Are quantity discounts clearly displayed near the main CTA?
Is free shipping (if applicable) highlighted near the main CTA?
Are certifications (e.g., FDA approved, eco-friendly) clearly displayed?
Is there a before-and-after section for products that promise visual results (e.g., skincare, cleaning products) to showcase the impact?
Does variant-specific information update dynamically based on the selected variant?
Is there a hassle-free returns process highlighted near the main CTA?
Is the product description easy to read and formatted for clarity?
Are there images available for each product variant?
Are all the assets optimized and compressed for faster loading times?
Are customer reviews prominently displayed with ratings, photos, and verified badges?
Are ingredients or materials clearly listed and visually showcased when applicable (e.g., cosmetics, food, supplements)?
Is the price of the product clearly visible and prominent?
Are product titles descriptive and clear?
Are recent reviews shown (newest from the last 3 months)?
Is the full ingredient list or nutrition / supplement facts readable on the page (text, or an image you can zoom)?
Is there help choosing a shade (shade finder, swatches on several skin tones, quiz)?
Is compatibility stated near the variant picker ("Fits iPhone 16 Pro")?
For shoppers in the EU, do prices include VAT and say so?
Does the page explain delivery for bulky items (to which room, assembly, delivery window)?
Can subscribers pause, skip or cancel by themselves, and does the product page say so?
Is there fit advice next to the size selector ("runs small, size up" or a size finder)?
Are the product's dimensions shown visually (a diagram or dimensions on a photo), not only in a table?
When a product is on sale, is the struck-through price the lowest price of the last 30 days?
Does each product page have its own clear title and description for Google results?
Does the page give Google its shipping and returns details (structured data), so they show in Google listings?
When a product link is shared, does the preview show the product image, name and price?
If the free shipping threshold is reached, is it clearly highlighted in the cart?
Is a "Verified Customer Reviews" badge displayed on the cart page?
Are the subtotal and total prices clearly displayed?
Are estimated taxes shown in the cart summary?
Is the correct product image displayed for the chosen product variant (e.g., Blue T-shirt)?
Is the suggested free shipping threshold clearly displayed?
Is the main CTA clear about the next step (e.g., “Proceed to Secure Checkout”)?
Are urgency triggers used effectively?
Is there information on easy returns or refunds visible on the cart page?
Is the expiration date for promotions clearly displayed on the cart or product pages?
Are scarcity triggers displayed next to each item?
Is the percentage discount displayed next to the discounted price?
Is there a "100% Secure Checkout" message displayed prominently?
Are thumbnail images of the products displayed in the cart?
Do input fields have floating labels to show the field name while entering data?
Does the checkout form highlight the border or background of the field the user is currently typing in?
Can users easily jump between input fields using the "Tab" key?
Is there an option to preselect "Billing address is the same as shipping" to minimize repetitive input?
Are numeric keyboards used for number-only fields on mobile?
Is the country code pre-selected based on the customer’s location for the phone number field?
Is there a countdown timer displaying the cutoff time for same-day or next-day dispatch?
Are input fields sized appropriately for the expected input (e.g., smaller fields for zip codes)?
Does the form use (real-time) inline validation with clear success/error indicators?
Does the checkout save input fields if the user leaves and returns later?
Is the checkout process clear about the next steps if it’s multi-step?
Is the checkout page SSL-encrypted, and does it display a secure URL (HTTPS)?
Is the user informed that their phone number is used only for specific purposes?
Do input fields include suggestions to reduce cognitive load (e.g., showing an email format)?
Are security seals and trust badges (e.g., SSL Secure, Norton Verified) visible on the checkout page?
Is password recovery easy during the checkout process?
Does the error state of incorrectly filled fields clearly state what is wrong and how to correct it?
If the store has a membership with free delivery, is it offered at checkout?
Are shipping rates and free shipping thresholds tested through A/B testing?
Does the page explain how the user can track their package?
Is there an FAQ section addressing common post-purchase questions?
Does search find products by category words ("sheets", "case"), not only by exact product names?
Does a search with no results offer a way forward (spelling fix, popular products, categories, contact)?
Can search results be filtered and sorted?
Do search results show products as cards with image, price and rating, like the category grid?
